architecture: Design review: callers are the composer only; replies follow the snippets module (src/snippets). Saved replies live in a new replies module next to the composer; U1 owns the API, U2 consumes it.

units.title: Saved reply storage
units.scope: Model, migration and API for saved replies.

criteria.statement: A saved reply appears in the picker after saving.

check.how: POST /api/replies then GET /api/replies and read the new reply back

personas.name: API client in a hurry
personas.behaviour: sends the same POST twice, omits optional fields

personas.name: malformed caller
personas.behaviour: sends empty bodies, huge text, wrong content type

personas.name: concurrent writer
personas.behaviour: fires parallel POSTs and reads straight after

criteria.statement: Picking a saved reply inserts its text at the cursor.

check.how: composer test: picking a reply inserts its text at the caret position

criteria.statement: An empty picker shows "No saved replies yet".

check.how: log in as a user with no replies, open the composer picker, read the empty state

personas.name: first-time agent on a slow laptop
personas.behaviour: double-clicks, uses the mouse, narrow window

personas.name: power user
personas.behaviour: keyboard only, pastes long text, opens the picker repeatedly

personas.name: careless user
personas.behaviour: submits empty, refreshes mid-flow, uses back
